subject.title: Feishu: replied/quoted message mentions show as raw @_user_N placeholders

question: Should maintainers adopt and narrow the open conflicting fork PR, or clear that path and queue a fresh Feishu-only repair for fetched quoted-message mention normalization?
rationale: The bug and owner boundary are clear, but an open conflicting fork PR still claims this issue while carrying the same broad diff that was closed unmerged in the target repo.

options.title: Clear Fork And Queue Fresh Repair
options.body: Treat the conflicting fork branch as non-viable and allow a narrow Feishu-only repair PR with focused tests and Feishu proof.

options.title: Adopt Only The Parser Idea
options.body: Manually salvage the fetched-message mention normalization idea from the fork while discarding unrelated branch changes.

options.title: Leave For Feishu Owner Implementation
options.body: Keep the issue open without automation until the Feishu plugin owner provides a narrow fix and proof.

recommendation.title: Clear Fork And Queue Fresh Repair
recommendation.body: Treat the conflicting fork branch as non-viable and allow a narrow Feishu-only repair PR with focused tests and Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is confined to the declared Feishu/Lark plugin ownership boundary and fetched-message context behavior.
